description: Every current champion across the promotions the API covers, with the division and the snapshot date the board was published. Pass org (e.g. "ufc") and/or division (e.g. "lightweight") to narrow it.

division.description: One division, e.g. "lightweight" or "womens-strawweight". Omit for every division.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion.

name: get_champions
title: Get current champions
